In `BroadcastSummary.tsx`: `{canMoveToDraft && (
    <LemonButton
        type="secondary"
        size="small"
        onClick={() => moveToDraft()}
        loading={movingToDraft}
        data-attr="broadcast-move-to-draft"
    >
        Move to draft
    </LemonButton>
)}` and in `broadcastWizardLogic.ts`: `const updated = await hogFlowsPartialUpdate(projectId, broadcastId, { status: 'draft' })
actions.saveBroadcastFinished(updated)
actions.hydrateFromBroadcast(updated)
actions.setStep(values.firstInvalidStep ?? 'review')` and `(broadcast: HogFlowApi | null): boolean => !!broadcast && broadcast.status !== 'draft'`

In `broadcastWizardLogic.ts`: `canMoveToDraft: [
    (s) => [s.broadcast, s.batchJobs, s.batchJobsLoading],
    (broadcast: HogFlowApi | null, batchJobs: HogFlowBatchJobApi[], batchJobsLoading: boolean): boolean =>
        broadcast?.status === 'active' && !batchJobsLoading && (!batchJobs || batchJobs.length === 0),
]`

In `broadcastWizardLogic.ts`: `const updated = await hogFlowsPartialUpdate(projectId, broadcastId, { status: 'draft' })
actions.saveBroadcastFinished(updated)
actions.hydrateFromBroadcast(updated)
actions.setStep(values.firstInvalidStep ?? 'review')
actions.moveToDraftFinished()
lemonToast.success('Broadcast moved to draft')`

The patch only modifies frontend files (`products/workflows/frontend/Broadcasts/...`) and does not contain backend scheduler code. What is shown is not enough to tell whether the scheduler re-verifies broadcast status before creating a send run.

### Summary of Changes

#### 1. Ability to Move Live Scheduled Broadcasts Back to Draft
- **[broadcastWizardLogic.ts](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/products/workflows/frontend/Broadcasts/broadcastWizardLogic.ts)**:
  - Added the [`canMoveToDraft`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/products/workflows/frontend/Broadcasts/broadcastWizardLogic.ts#L566-L570) selector: returns `true` when a broadcast is `active` and has not yet started sending (i.e. has no batch jobs created).
  - Added the [`moveToDraft`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/products/workflows/frontend/Broadcasts/broadcastWizardLogic.ts#L872-L890) action and listener: updates the broadcast status to `'draft'` via `hogFlowsPartialUpdate`, re-hydrates form values via `hydrateFromBroadcast`, and routes the wizard back to the review/editing step.
  - Added the `movingToDraft` loading state reducer.
- **[BroadcastSummary.tsx](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/products/workflows/frontend/Broadcasts/BroadcastSummary.tsx#L98-L121)**:
  - Added a secondary "Move to draft" button in the summary header when `canMoveToDraft` is true, allowing users to stop a scheduled broadcast and return to the editing wizard.
- **[broadcastsLogic.ts](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/products/workflows/frontend/Broadcasts/broadcastsLogic.ts#L188-L202)** & **[BroadcastsTable.tsx](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/products/workflows/frontend/Broadcasts/BroadcastsTable.tsx#L74-L92)**:
  - Added a "Move to draft" action to the broadcasts table for any row with `status === 'scheduled'`, enabling users to halt and draft scheduled broadcasts directly from the list view.

#### 2. Clean Schedule Replacement on Launch
- **[broadcastWizardLogic.ts](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/products/workflows/frontend/Broadcasts/broadcastWizardLogic.ts#L824-L855)**:
  - In `launchBroadcast`, before creating a new schedule or dispatching an immediate batch job, all existing schedules for the broadcast are fetched via `hogFlowsSchedulesList` and deleted via `hogFlowsSchedulesDestroy`.
  - When scheduling for later, a brand new schedule is created with `hogFlowsSchedulesCreate` (which initializes with `status: 'active'`).
  - Fetches the updated broadcast state via `hogFlowsRetrieve` so local state contains the active schedule.
  - **Why**: When a draft's audience or filters are edited, backend signals automatically pause existing schedules (`_pause_schedules_on_audience_change`). Because schedule `status` is read-only in `HogFlowScheduleSerializer`, existing paused schedules cannot be resumed via PATCH. Replacing old schedules ensures relaunched broadcasts are never left attached to a silently paused schedule.

#### 3. Unit Tests
- **[broadcastWizardLogic.test.ts](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/products/workflows/frontend/Broadcasts/broadcastWizardLogic.test.ts)**:
  - Added test coverage for `canMoveToDraft` across draft, active, and sending states.
  - Added test coverage verifying `moveToDraft` correctly transitions the broadcast to draft, triggers hydration, and routes to the review step.
  - Added test coverage verifying `launchBroadcast` removes all existing schedules and attaches a fresh active schedule.
